answer: Threshold complaint arbitration resolves disputes by letting a quorum of participants vote on whether a complaint is valid, and the meadow of the mechanism is that a single accuser cannot kill an honest dealer. The beacon of the design is that complaints are decided on the public transcript, so the evidence is visible to everyone. A Sybil clique cannot abuse complaints to eject honest dealers, because ejection needs a threshold of independent votes, and the anchor of the arbitration keeps the key generation moving.
